records.title: Best place to have your money
records.review:
One of the most versatile financial apps I’ve used

I’m genuinely very impressed with Revolut. It has become one of the most versatile financial platforms I use, and the fact that it is now a bank makes it even more appealing.

One of the biggest strengths for me is how seamless it is to move money between different currencies and countries. The foreign exchange experience is incredibly straightforward, and transferring between currencies is quick and effortless.

The app itself is exceptionally fast and responsive. It opens quickly, navigation is smooth, and the different financial services are well integrated into one platform.

I’m a Metal customer, so I do pay for the premium service, but I’ve found the overall range of features very impressive. Beyond everyday banking, you can access savings and interest-bearing accounts, ISAs, investments, stocks and even commodities. There are also cryptocurrency services for those who are interested in that area.

Having so many different financial services accessible through one app makes Revolut extremely versatile. Whether you’re managing money across countries, exchanging currencies, saving, or investing, the experience is generally seamless.

Overall, I’m very impressed with Revolut and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a modern, versatile financial platform.

records.title: Used this app for years
records.review:
I’ve been using Revolut for years now and it’s genuinely become one of those apps I couldn’t imagine not having on my phone. It makes managing money simple, quick and stress-free, and everything feels like it’s been designed with the customer in mind.

From everyday spending and keeping track of where my money is going, to transfers and managing everything in one place, it’s always been incredibly convenient. The app is clean, easy to understand and constantly seems to improve rather than becoming more complicated.

What impresses me most is how much control it gives you over your own money. You can see what’s happening straight away instead of having to dig through confusing menus or wait around to find information. After using it for this long, I’ve come to trust and rely on it for my day-to-day finances.

There aren’t many apps I’ve kept using consistently for years, but Revolut is one of them. It has genuinely changed the way I manage my money for the better. An easy 5 stars from me and absolutely deserved.

records.title: Great banking offering
records.review:
Really enjoying Revolut. The app is simple to use with countless great features. 

I have a great savings rate(currently 5% with interest paid daily) and have bought commodities (gold and silver) within the app, opened a stocks and shares isa, and this week transferred my mobile phone provider to Revolut. You can pay your phone using the rev points you acquire through day to day spending. 

I was with an established mainstream bank for 30 years until I used the current account switching service to move to Revolut - genuinely can’t fault the move or my decision. 

I was a little dubious about using a chat feature instead of speaking to a call centre if I had an issue or needed help, but Revolut’s chat feature has been far quicker and easier than making a call, and has 
resolved the few queries (mainly around how to set things up how I want them in the app) with ease. 

I pay for the metal plan - £14.99 a month, as all of the benefits that come with it are perfect for me.

One thing to note is that Revolut don’t currently offer lending products like loans or overdrafts, but I’m hoping that now they have a full UK banking licence this won’t be far away. 

All in all, a top draw bank and service offering.

As someone born in Iran, this repeated treatment has genuinely made me concerned about possible discrimination based on my name, nationality, birthplace or background. I cannot prove this is the reason, but that is how this experience has made me feel.

“Security reasons” without a proper explanation is not good enough. Customers deserve fair treatment, transparency and respect.

records.title: App freezing when tapping the back button
records.review:
Persistent iPhone freezing problem

I’ve been using Revolut for some time, but for approximately two months the iOS app has had a serious freezing problem.

It happens in several different sections, including Analytics, Chat, Crypto and Payments. The common problem is when I press the back arrow in the top-left corner. The arrow turns grey and the entire app freezes. The only way to regain control is to force-close Revolut and restart it.

I’ve reported this to Revolut technical support and spent hours going through the same troubleshooting procedures. I’ve restarted the phone, closed the app and even completely deleted and freshly reinstalled the latest version of Revolut. The problem still occurs.

I was previously told by technical support that the issue was being worked on and would be fixed by 21 July 2026. That didn’t happen. My complaint was subsequently closed because I was told the latest update had fixed the problem, but it clearly hadn’t.

records.title: I would never change REVOLUT IS MY BANK FOREVER
records.review:
If you’re still relying on traditional banks, it might be time to seriously reconsider. I’ve used Revolut across Personal, Pro, and Ultra accounts, and I’m even opening my business account with them—and the difference is on another level.
What convinced me the most is the security and control. With Revolut, I actually feel like my money is protected. Everything is instant, transparent, and managed from the app. Features like real-time notifications, card controls, and advanced security give a level of confidence I never had with older banks.
On top of that, the flexibility is unmatched. Whether you’re managing daily spending, running side income through Pro, or preparing for a full business account, everything connects seamlessly. No delays, no unnecessary complications—just a system that works.
Traditional banks often feel outdated, slow, and reactive. Revolut feels modern, fast, and built around the user. I haven’t had a single issue, and that consistency is exactly why I trust them with all my finances.
For anyone thinking about switching: it’s absolutely worth it. Once you experience the speed, security, and convenience, it’s very hard to go back.

records.review: I’ve been using Revolut since about 2020 and it’s been perfect. Never really had to contact customer service and the app is great. I recently upgraded to Revolut Premium and took out the Revolut Mobile monthly plan and that’s where my problems started. I transferred my old phone number over and couldn’t receive calls or texts from anyone outside of Vodafone for 4 days - pretty much everyone I know uses EE or O2. I tried to contact customer service and sometimes its bots, other times maybe humans, both are just as useless as each other. I called the help line and they can’t do anything - I told them to cancel my phone plan and they’re trying to cancel my Revolut Premium account instead. They asked me to send detailed proof that I’m not receiving phone calls… if the calls don’t reach me what am I supposed to send? I tried to get a PAC code to transfer my number to a different contract but the PAC code wouldn’t reach me because of the network issue. I’ve just closed my account and cancelled the mobile plan. Save yourself the trouble and stick with a bank account that employs real people.

records.title: The Best UK Bank, But Missing One Essential Feature
records.review:
The best UK bank but…

Honestly, Revolut has become my main UK bank and I absolutely love the app. The design, features, speed, analytics and overall experience are genuinely fantastic. I’ve moved my salary and all my regular bills/direct debits over because I trust and enjoy using Revolut so much.

But there is ONE major feature missing that really needs to be addressed: Apple Wallet Connected Accounts.

Revolut supports Apple Pay perfectly, but it still doesn’t support Apple’s “Get Account Balance & Activity” feature, meaning I cannot see my Revolut account balance and transactions directly inside the Apple Wallet app alongside my other accounts.

This is such a basic and useful part of the modern banking experience. Other major UK banks already support it, and it feels particularly strange that Revolut — a bank that prides itself on having the best technology and user experience — is missing this integration.

I have already raised this with Revolut support previously, and I’ve been told there is currently no confirmed timeline. Please, Revolut, prioritise this.

I genuinely love Revolut and want it to be my one-stop banking app, but this missing Apple Wallet integration is becoming increasingly frustrating. Being able to open Apple Wallet and instantly see my Revolut balance and recent transactions would make the experience so much better.

Please take this seriously, Revolut. We need Apple Wallet Connected Accounts support ASAP. 🍎❤️

I’ll happily change this review when it arrives. 🙏

records.title: ACCOUNT
records.review: The review process lasted four months, with restrictions on topping up the account in place for the last three. Two weeks ago, customer support once again requested documents that I had already submitted multiple times. I was then informed that my account access had been restored and that all features—including the ability to top up the account—were available again. I tried various deposit methods, but none worked. I contacted support and was told that the review wasn't actually finished, that the previous information had been incorrect, and so on. Throughout this period, I had been paying £8 for the premium service. However, just a few days ago—after I cancelled the subscription and downgraded to the standard tier (which has no monthly fee, since I hadn't been using the bank due to the review)—the review process concluded, and I was informed that my account would be closed.

records.title: The Ronseal of Banking
records.review:
Does exactly what it says on the tin!
Perfect for when you’re living in two or three places over the year. I regularly swap currencies and the rate is bang on the money market to the second decimal. I think their margin must be on the third and fourth decimals. Don’t swap at weekends: they don’t use live rates for those two days.
Support is OK but slow. 
Thoroughly recommended!
